subject: Replace dicebear with custom in-house avatar generation
message:
Replace dicebear with custom in-house avatar generation

Replaces the external dicebear dependency with a custom, optimized Python
implementation for generating dynamic avatars. This change reduces
dependencies, improves performance, and gives us full control over avatar
generation.

Key improvements:
- Pure Python implementation with zero external dependencies (no subprocess)
- Enhanced unicode support with proper NFC normalization
- Deterministic avatar generation using seeded randomness
- Better initials extraction logic (inherited from existing implementation)
- Clean SVG generation with minimal code
- Support for 'initials' and 'shapes' modes matching dicebear's feel

Implementation details:
- Uses Python's random.Random() for deterministic PRNG
- Generates SVG strings directly without external tools
- Material Design color palette for consistency
- Proper XML escaping for security
- Maintains caching behavior via CacheService

Files changed:
- Created app/lib/avatar.py with generate_avatar() API
- Updated app/controllers/web_image.py to use new module
- Removed app/lib/dicebear.py and subprocess-based generation
- Updated tests/lib/test_avatar.py with comprehensive test cases
- Removed dicebear from package.json dependencies

subject: Implement user follow system
message:
Implement user follow system

This commit implements a complete user follow system with the following features:

Backend:
- Add user_follow table to database migration (0.sql)
- Create UserFollow model with follower_id, followee_id, and created_at
- Implement UserFollowQuery with:
  - is_following() to check follow status
  - list_following() and list_followers() with pagination
  - resolve_is_following() to decorate user lists
  - count helpers for following/followers
- Implement UserFollowService with:
  - follow() action with email notification on first follow
  - unfollow() action (idempotent)
  - Self-follow prevention

subject: feat: Implement TOTP-based 2FA backend infrastructure
message:
feat: Implement TOTP-based 2FA backend infrastructure

Add comprehensive two-factor authentication using RFC 6238 TOTP standard.
This is the backend implementation; frontend UI will follow in next commit.

Core Features:
- TOTP secret generation and verification (SHA-1, 30s window, 6 digits)
- Client-side secret generation, server-side verification only
- AES-CTR encryption for secret storage using existing SECRET_32
- Replay attack prevention with used-code tracking
- Time window tolerance (t-1, t, t+1) for clock drift
- Distributed-safe implementation with PostgreSQL constraints

Database Changes:
- Add user_totp table: stores encrypted TOTP secrets per user
- Add user_totp_used_code table: prevents code reuse within time windows
- Add audit types: add_2fa, remove_2fa, auth_2fa_fail
- Add audit policies for 2FA events (60-day retention for setup/removal)

Backend Implementation:
- app/lib/totp.py: RFC 6238 TOTP core (generate_secret, verify_code, etc.)
- app/lib/crypto.py: Enable AES-CTR encrypt/decrypt functions
- app/services/user_totp_service.py: Setup, verify, remove with replay prevention
- app/models/db/user_totp.py: UserTOTP TypedDict model
- app/queries/user_totp_query.py: Database queries for TOTP credentials
- app/exceptions/totp_mixin.py: TOTP-specific exception types

API Endpoints:
- POST /api/web/settings/totp/setup: Enable 2FA (verify code + store secret)
- POST /api/web/settings/totp/remove: Disable 2FA (requires password)
- POST /api/web/admin/users/{id}/remove-totp: Admin force-remove 2FA
- Modified POST /api/web/user/login: Two-step flow for 2FA users

Authentication Flow:
1. User submits password → server checks validity
2. If 2FA enabled → return {requires_2fa: true}
3. User re-submits password + TOTP code → verify both
4. Prevent code replay across all valid time windows
5. Update last_used_at and clean up old used codes

Security Measures:
- Secrets encrypted at rest with AES-CTR
- Replay prevention via unique constraint on (user_id, time_window, code_hash)
- Automatic cleanup of old used codes (keep last 90 seconds)
- Audit trail for all 2FA operations
- Admin oversight: view status and force-remove capability

Dependencies:
- Add pycryptodome for AES encryption (well-vetted, focused library)

Next Steps:
- Frontend QR code generation and setup UI
- Frontend login 2FA input
- Locale strings
- Admin UI enhancements
- Testing
